title: Explicit external section components and their naturality
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and let $F,G$ be module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every open $V$ of $Y$, define $L_V(s)$ by the first projection pullback unit on $s\in\Gamma(X,F)$ followed by restriction to $\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}V$, and define $R_V(t)$ by the second projection pullback unit on $t\in G(V)$, as in [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison]. The formula $s\otimes t\mapsto L_V(s)\otimes R_V(t)$ defines a $k$-linear map $c_V$ to sections of the external coefficient on $\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}V$. These explicitly constructed maps commute with restrictions for every inclusion of opens of $Y$.

source.place: Tag 0BED, degree-zero cup product and omitted canonical-map verification; restriction comparisons use Tags 0096, 0097, 01CD

proof.text: Define scalarUnitSection by the actual pullback-adjunction unit. The equality of scalar structure maps follows by evaluating naturality of the scheme ring map on the restriction from the top open. This proves k-linearity. Restrict the first unit at top to the inverse image of V and use the second unit at V. Their tensor section is bilinear over k, since pr_1 composed with f equals pr_2 composed with g. Apply TensorProduct.lift to obtain the explicit externalSectionsComponent.

To prove naturality, test the equality of linear maps on pure tensors (TensorProduct.ext'). The first factor commutes with restriction by composition of presheaf maps. The second factor commutes by Hom.app_presheaf_map applied to the adjunction unit. Apply tmulSection_map and congruence in its two arguments. This also proves compatibility for the empty open and for zero sections.

theorem externalSectionsComponent_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) {U V : Y.Opensᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    (scalarPresheaf g G ⋙ MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft (scalarObj f F (op ⊤))).map i ≫
        externalSectionsComponent f g F G V.unop =
      externalSectionsComponent f g F G U.unop ≫
        scalarRestriction (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)
          ((Opens.map (pullback.snd f g).base).map i.unop).op
